title: Proverbs Chapter 12 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Proverbs chapter 12 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Proverbs Chapter 12 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Proverbs Chapter 12.

questions.question: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge. What does he that hateth reproof resemble?
questions.explanation: He that hateth reproof is brutish, as stated in Proverbs 12:1.

questions.question: What does a good man obtain from the LORD?
questions.explanation: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD according to Proverbs 12:2.

questions.question: A man shall not be established by what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:3 states that a man shall not be established by wickedness.

questions.question: What does a virtuous woman represent to her husband?
questions.explanation: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband as stated in Proverbs 12:4.

questions.question: True or False: The thoughts of the righteous are right.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:5 confirms that the thoughts of the righteous are right.

questions.question: What do the words of the wicked lie in wait for?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:6 states that the words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood.

questions.question: True or False: The house of the wicked shall stand.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:7 states that the wicked are overthrown, and are not, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

questions.question: A man shall be commended according to what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:8 indicates that a man shall be commended according to his wisdom.

questions.question: True or False: He that is despised and hath a servant is better than he that honoureth himself and lacketh bread.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:9 shows that he that is despised and hath a servant is better than he that honoureth himself and lacketh bread.

questions.question: What does a righteous man regard according to Proverbs 12:10?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:10 states that a righteous man regardeth the life of his beast.

questions.question: In Proverbs 12, which instruction comes before all the others listed here?
options: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD
The wicked desireth the net of evil men
A man shall not be established by wickedness
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:1 is the first instruction in the chapter.

questions.question: The hand of the diligent shall bear what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:24 states that the hand of the diligent shall bear rule.

questions.question: What does heaviness in the heart of man do?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:25 states that heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop.

questions.question: True or False: The lip of truth will be established for a moment.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:19 states that the lip of truth shall be established for ever.

medium.title: Proverbs Chapter 12 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Proverbs Chapter 12 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 12:11, what is the consequence of following vain persons?
options: He shall be satisfied with bread
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:11 states that 'he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding,' indicating that pursuing empty or meaningless pursuits leads to a lack of wisdom.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 12:14 say a man shall be satisfied with?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:14 states that 'a man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth,' showing that the words and actions of a person can lead to satisfaction.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 12:15, who is considered wise?
options: The one who hearkeneth unto counsel
questions.correctAnswer: The one who hearkeneth unto counsel
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:15 teaches that 'he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise,' indicating the value of seeking and listening to advice.

questions.question: Proverbs 12:18 compares the words of the wise to what?
questions.explanation: The verse states that 'the tongue of the wise is health,' indicating that wise speech can promote well-being.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 12:20 say is found in the heart of those who imagine evil?
questions.explanation: According to Proverbs 12:20, 'deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil,' emphasizing the negative impact of harboring evil thoughts.

questions.question: True or False: A righteous man cares for his animals according to Proverbs 12:10.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:10 states, 'A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast,' affirming the compassionate nature of a righteous person.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 12:12 say about the root of the righteous?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:12 indicates that 'the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit,' signifying the productive outcomes of righteousness.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 12:22 states that lying lips are a delight to the LORD.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:22 declares, 'Lying lips are abomination to the LORD,' indicating that God detests falsehood.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 12:25, what can make a man's heart stoop?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:25 states, 'Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop,' highlighting the burden that sorrow can bring.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 12:13 say about the wicked?
options: They are snared by their lips
questions.correctAnswer: They are snared by their lips
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:13 asserts that 'the wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips,' showing how their own words can trap them.

questions.question: True or False: According to Proverbs 12:26, the righteous is less excellent than his neighbor.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:26 states, 'The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour,' indicating superiority in righteousness.

questions.question: What is the difference between a fool and a prudent man according to Proverbs 12:16?
options: A prudent man shows his anger
A fool's wrath is known, but a prudent man covers shame
questions.correctAnswer: A fool's wrath is known, but a prudent man covers shame
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:16 explains that 'a fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame,' contrasting the reactions of foolishness and prudence.

hard.title: Proverbs Chapter 12 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Proverbs Chapter 12.

questions.question: What shall happen to the just according to Proverbs 12:21?
options: Evil shall not happen to them
They shall be filled with sorrow
questions.correctAnswer: Evil shall not happen to them
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:21 states, 'There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief,' indicating that the just are protected from evil.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 12:22, what type of lips are an abomination to the LORD?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:22 clearly says, 'Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight,' emphasizing God's disdain for dishonesty.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 12:24 say about the diligent and the slothful?
options: The diligent shall bear rule, the slothful shall be under tribute
questions.correctAnswer: The diligent shall bear rule, the slothful shall be under tribute
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:24 states, 'The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute,' showing the reward of diligence and the consequence of laziness.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 12:26 imply about the righteous in comparison to their neighbor?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:26 declares, 'The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them,' implying a moral superiority of the righteous.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 12:25, what can make a man's heart stoop?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:25 states, 'Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad,' indicating that sorrow can weigh down the heart.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 12:28 state about the way of righteousness?
options: It is a path of confusion
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:28 says, 'In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death,' highlighting the life-giving nature of righteousness.

questions.question: True or False: A prudent man conceals knowledge according to Proverbs 12:23.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:23 states, 'A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness,' showing that wisdom often involves discretion.

questions.question: What happens to the wicked according to Proverbs 12:21?
options: They shall be filled with mischief
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be filled with mischief
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:21 says, 'but the wicked shall be filled with mischief,' indicating that the wicked will experience trouble and chaos.

questions.question: True or False: The tongue of the wise is likened to health in Proverbs 12:18.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:18 states, 'but the tongue of the wise is health,' indicating that wise words can bring healing and wellness.

questions.question: Which literary device is used in Proverbs 12:22, contrasting two types of lips?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:22 employs parallelism, contrasting 'Lying lips' with 'they that deal truly' to emphasize the dichotomy between dishonesty and truth.

questions.question: What does the Hebrew word for 'righteous' imply in the context of Proverbs 12:25?
questions.explanation: In the context of Proverbs 12:25, the Hebrew term for 'righteous' encompasses meanings of innocence, justice, and morality, reflecting a holistic view of righteousness.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 12:27, what does the substance of a diligent man represent?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:27 states, 'but the substance of a diligent man is precious,' highlighting the value of the work produced by diligence.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 12:13 describe the fate of the wicked?
options: They are snared by their own lips
questions.correctAnswer: They are snared by their own lips
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:13 states, 'The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble,' indicating that the wicked's own words bring them trouble.

theological.title: Proverbs Chapter 12 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Proverbs Chapter 12 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 12:1 teach about the value of instruction?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:1 states that 'Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge,' indicating that valuing instruction is essential for gaining knowledge. This reflects the importance of wisdom in life (James 1:5).

questions.question: According to Proverbs 12:2, what is the fate of a man with wicked devices?
options: He will obtain favor of the Lord
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:2 says, 'but a man of wicked devices will he condemn,' indicating that God condemns those who engage in wickedness (Galatians 6:7).

questions.question: What does Proverbs 12:3 teach about the establishment of a man?
questions.explanation: The verse states, 'A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved,' emphasizing that true stability comes from righteousness (Psalm 1:3).

questions.question: What is said about a virtuous woman in Proverbs 12:4?
options: She is a crown to her husband
questions.correctAnswer: She is a crown to her husband
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:4 highlights that 'A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband,' signifying her value and honor in the marriage relationship (Ephesians 5:25-28).

questions.question: What do the thoughts of the righteous produce according to Proverbs 12:5?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:5 states, 'The thoughts of the righteous are right,' indicating that righteousness influences one’s actions positively (Philippians 4:8).

questions.question: According to Proverbs 12:6, what is the purpose of the words of the wicked?
questions.explanation: The verse states that 'The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood,' showing the malicious intent behind their speech (James 3:16).

questions.question: What does Proverbs 12:10 say about a righteous man’s regard for animals?
options: He regards the life of his beast
questions.correctAnswer: He regards the life of his beast
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:10 indicates that 'A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast,' showing compassion and stewardship, aligning with God's care for creation (Genesis 1:28).

questions.question: What is the consequence of following vain persons as stated in Proverbs 12:11?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:11 warns that 'he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding,' emphasizing the importance of wise associations (1 Corinthians 15:33).

questions.question: What does Proverbs 12:19 reveal about truth and lying?
options: Lies are more powerful than truth
The lip of truth shall be established for ever
questions.correctAnswer: The lip of truth shall be established for ever
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:19 asserts that 'The lip of truth shall be established for ever,' indicating the permanence and reliability of truth (John 8:32).

questions.question: According to Proverbs 12:22, what does the Lord delight in?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:22 states, 'but they that deal truly are his delight,' highlighting the value God places on honesty (Psalm 51:6).

questions.question: What does Proverbs 12:25 say about the impact of words on the heart?
options: A good word maketh it glad
questions.correctAnswer: A good word maketh it glad
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:25 teaches that 'a good word maketh it glad,' demonstrating the uplifting power of encouraging speech (Ephesians 4:29).

questions.question: What insight do Proverbs 12:12 and 12:27 provide about diligence?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:27 states, 'the substance of a diligent man is precious,' while 12:12 highlights how the righteous yield fruit, showing that diligence and righteousness are fruitful (Colossians 3:23-24).

questions.question: What does Proverbs 12:28 suggest about the way of righteousness?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:28 declares, 'In the way of righteousness is life,' affirming that living righteously aligns with God's purpose for abundant life (John 10:10).

questions.question: What combined teaching do Proverbs 12:15 and 12:18 convey about wisdom and foolishness?
options: Fools are wise in their own eyes
questions.correctAnswer: Fools are wise in their own eyes
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:15 says, 'The way of a fool is right in his own eyes,' and 12:18 compares the tongue of the wise to a health-giving force, indicating that true wisdom contrasts with foolish self-deception (Proverbs 1:7).

questions.question: Sceptics claim that truth is subjective and varies from person to person. What does Proverbs 12:17-19 actually teach?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:17 emphasizes that 'He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness,' while 12:19 declares the permanence of truth, countering the sceptic's claim that truth is subjective (John 14:6).
